item.title: Car parked obstructing lane and causing traffic., 21st October
item.description:
Council puts cameras on LTN quiet roads forcing the traffic on main roads. Then they don't put anything in place to manage traffic violations on these main roads. This creates lateness, frustration as drivers constantly have to report it. Please install a camera on the lamp posts with a notice advising drivers so that a ticket can automatically be issued. This BMW has been parked in that lane everyday for over a week.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Station Road, Southgate
